span: a suit simpliciter for specific performance of contract for sale of land is a suit for enforcement of terms of contract
why: Concerns whether a specific-performance suit is a suit for land (jurisdiction), not whether an oral agreement is enforceable.

span: time is not of the essence in an agreement for the sale of immoveable property
why: General equitable considerations on specific performance of a written agreement; oral or unregistered agreements are not discussed.

span: The suit for specific performance of an Agreement of Sale of an immovable property, filed by the respondent herein, was decreed by the Trial Court
why: Procedural history of a suit on a written agreement dated 19.06.1993; no oral agreement is in issue.

span: the jurisdiction to decree a suit for specific performance is a discretionary jurisdiction
why: General discretion under s.20 of the Specific Relief Act, not the oral-agreement question.

span: suits for specific performance are arbitrable despite the fact that the court is vested with discretion
why: Arbitrability of specific-performance claims, not enforceability of oral agreements.

span: the suit agreement of sale dated 12.06.1980 is true, valid and enforceable
why: Trial court's finding on a written agreement of sale; oral agreements are not in issue.

span: Relief of specific performance of a contract is no longer discretionary, after the amendment.
why: Effect of the 2018 amendment on specific performance generally; no distinction between oral and written agreements.

span: The issue, in our opinion, is no more res integra.
why: Court adopts the position that an unregistered document can be received as evidence of the contract in a suit for specific performance, which supports enforcing an unregistered agreement; the document is written and unregistered, not a purely oral agreement.

span: Respondent agreed to sell immovable property to petitioner under an agreement entered in 1994
why: Headnote on amendment of the plaint and court fee for a specific-performance claim, not on oral agreements.
